description: This file defines database repository functions for managing dealer, stock, payment, and payroll data, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM. It includes functions for creating and listing dealers, stock entries, payroll credits, and payments, as well as computing ledger summaries for a dealer.

methods.name: Dealer create_dealer(db: Session, *, name: str, phone: str | None, address: str | None)
methods.description: Creates a new dealer record in the database with provided name, phone, and address.

methods.name: list[Dealer] list_dealers(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of all dealers ordered by name.

methods.name: Dealer|None get_dealer(db: Session, dealer_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a dealer by its unique ID.

methods.name: StockEntry create_stock_entry( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, item_name: str, quantity: int, unit_cost: Decimal, stock_date: dt.date | None, )
methods.description: Creates a stock entry record for a dealer with specified item details and quantity.

methods.name: PayrollCredit create_payroll_credit( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, description: str | None, amount: Decimal, credit_date: dt.date | None, )
methods.description: Creates a payroll or credit entry for a dealer with an optional description.

methods.name: Payment create_payment( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, amount: Decimal, paid_at: dt.datetime | None, note: str | None, )
methods.description: Creates a payment record associated with a dealer.

methods.name: dict[str,Decimal]|None compute_dealer_ledger_summary(db: Session, dealer_id: int)
methods.description: Calculates and returns summary totals (stock, payroll credits, payments, balance due) for a dealer.
